scope: Theorem 3.1 (Local stretching) of the manuscript “Positive scalar curvature and uniform codimension-two width” (preprints/Positive-scalar-curvature-and-uniform-codimension-two-width-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 336 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f67c30579306bd4d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix n ≥ 2 and 0 < δ < 1/10, and put L∗ = 1.004. There are constants W, T ≥ 1, depending only on n, δ, with the following property. Let h0 be a complete smooth metric on a manifold Mn without boundary, let h ≥ h0 be smooth, and let t ≥ T be smooth. Let A be a nonempty compact set and B a nonempty closed set such that disth0 (A, B) ≥ W. For every 0 < d < δ there are smooth h′ ≥ h and t′ ≥ t such that the changes have compact support in {disth0 (A, ·) < W}, D(h′ , t′ ) ≥ D(h, t) + (t′2 − t2 ) − δ trh h0 − trh′ h0  t′2 − dt′2 , (3.1) and disth′ (A, B) ≥ L∗W. (3.2) In particular, h′ is complete. Neither W nor T depends on d, the geometry of M, or the sets A, B.
